subject.title: Tustin Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: Governing Board Member, Tustin Unified School District, Trustee Area 5

As a longtime Tustin Unified Trustee, I've helped guide our students to some of the strongest results of any school district in California: a 97% graduation rate, faster learning gains than the state average, and reading and math scores among the top 20% in the nation. I'm leading our expanding workforce and career pathways so every graduate leaves ready for what's next.

I also worked with my colleagues to save taxpayers over $48 million through smart bond restructuring, and championed districtwide modernization, ensuring Tustin Unified schools benefit from upgraded classrooms, new facilities, and enhanced safety and security features.

I believe strong schools are built through partnership, which is why my service to Tustin doesn't stop at the dais. I serve as President of Tustin Scholarships and Executive Vice President of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Tustin, working alongside educators, staff, and families every day.

It's also why I'm proud to carry the sole endorsement of the Tustin Educators Association, representing our classroom teachers, along with support from local leaders like Congressman Dave Min, Assemblymember Cottie Petrie-Norris, former Tustin Mayor Letitia Clark, and dozens more.
I'm running for re-election to keep this momentum going for every Tustin Unified student, and I look forward to earning your vote on or before November 3, 2026.

text: I am running for the Tustin Unified School District Board of Education because every decision should begin with one question:

For more than seven years I have served TUSD as a Library Media Technician and Literacy Specialist, helping students develop a love of reading, strengthen critical thinking, and build confidence. By modernizing library programs, leading family literacy initiatives, and supporting parents, I have seen firsthand how strong public schools change lives.

My experience also includes securing grants, managing budgets, coordinating volunteers, directing youth camps, and building community partnerships. These roles have prepared me to make thoughtful, responsible decisions that support students, educators, and families.

As a Board member I will keep students at the center of every decision, support our teachers and staff, promote academic excellence and be responsible with fiscal stewardship. I will work to strengthen parent partnerships, and ensure transparency, open communication, safe schools, and balanced technology use.
Tustin Unified is exceptional because of its outstanding students, dedicated educators, and engaged families. I would be honored to help our district continue to thrive for generations to come.
